business_problem.statement: Classify inbound software-service requests by request type, then evaluate whether a routing policy could reduce unnecessary handoffs without missing high-risk cases.
business_outcomes: acceptable incident escalation and SLA risk
business_problem.target_customer: Illustrative B2B IT delivery/service desk; no customer or production deployment exists
business_problem.taxonomy_selection: Use observed source classes when benchmarking. In production, perform discovery and jointly define categories, urgency, SOPs, costs and ownership with the customer before system design.

dimensions.urgency: Unknown in NLBSE labels; NEVER infer severity from request-type alone
dimensions.service_domain: Optional client-specific multi-label field; Analytics/Automation/Integration/Incident Response NOT source classes

classification.source_type: Real public software issue reports, English; harmonized source labels from source repositories
classification.label_provenance: Source GitHub issues; category synonyms harmonized by NLBSE organizers. No claim that every record carries an identical original raw label.
classification.primary_metric: macro_F1 plus per-class precision/recall and overall accuracy
classification.evaluation_rule: Original NLBSE benchmark requires full 142,320 test cases for official comparable scores; a smaller diagnostic subsample is NOT the official benchmark
classification.raw_republication: Not authorized by this project; no raw issue text republished
classification.strength: Real labeled text and large independent split
classification.limitation: No authoritatively linked urgency, handling time, person-hours, cost, or client outcomes

operations.source_type: Anonymized historical Volvo IT incident event log
available_evidence: organization handoffs as derived process statistic
operations.scope: Incident operations; does not cover the four old service classes
operations.raw_republication: Not authorized by this project; summary counts only

official_labor_cost_reference.statistic: Average employer labor cost per hour worked, not Volvo wages and not measured ticket cost
official_labor_cost_reference.source: Destatis Arbeitskosten 2025, Wirtschaftszweig Information und Kommunikation

economics.model: Illustrative potential labor saving = observed event-log handoffs × ASSUMED avoidable share × ASSUMED minutes saved per avoided handoff × reference EUR/h ÷ 60; deduct actual measured model, reviewer and ops costs where available
economics.forbidden_inference: Do not multiply observed elapsed wall-clock hours by the wage rate: elapsed ≠ active staff hours
economics.causal_limit: No randomized/paired rollout; cannot claim avoided handoffs, realized ROI or SLA improvements
economics.cross_source_limit: No row-level join from NLBSE software issues to Volvo incidents; do not imply a common population or derive a single end-to-end observed performance score
economics.rollout_condition: Actual customer SLA, cost, review and deployment constraints must be measured prospectively

disclosure.old_32_cases: Historical 32 labeled synthetic pilot, exploratory and not NLBSE
